```{r}
library(tidyverse)
files<-list.files("/media/Lawrenson_Lab_NAS/uthscsa/group_data/CosMx_temp",full.names = T)
files<-files[str_detect(files,"SL")]
files<-list.files(files,full.names = T)
files<-files[str_detect(files,"csv")]
data<-lapply(files,data.table::fread)
#8.5 GB 
names(data)<-str_remove_all(files,".+temp\\/|.pix.+")
sapply(data,nrow)#size in aggregated pixels
#SL260087 SL260088 SL260089 SL260090 SL260091 SL260092 
#27393755 21820185 45917164 29486608 33403504 19856764

data<-lapply(data,function(x) 
  x%>%mutate(across(PGP95:CD20,function(x) asinh(x/5))))
#should robustly scale using the 1st–99th percentiles instead
data<-lapply(data,function(x) 
    x%>%mutate(across(PGP95:CD20,function(x) (x-quantile(x,.01))/(quantile(x,.99)-quantile(x,.01)))))
data<-lapply(data,function(x) 
  x%>%mutate(across(PGP95:CD20,function(x) case_when(x>1~1,x<0~0,TRUE~x))))

temp<-sapply(data,function(x) colMeans(x[,3:7]))
temp<-temp%>%t()%>%as.data.frame()%>%rownames_to_column("Sample")
temp<-sapply(data,nrow)%>%as.data.frame()%>%
  rownames_to_column("Sample")%>%inner_join(temp)
colnames(temp)[2]<-"points"
```

```{r}
filtered<-lapply(data,function(x)
  x%>%pivot_longer(PGP95:CD20,names_to = "protein",values_to = "signal"))
filtered<-lapply(filtered,function(x) 
  x%>%filter(signal>.9)%>%add_count(x,y)%>%filter(n<3))
filtered<-lapply(filtered,function(x) 
  x%>%group_by(x,y)%>%
  mutate(pair=ifelse(n==2,
                     paste(unique(protein),collapse = ','),
                     "single")))
filtered<-lapply(filtered,function(x)
  x%>%filter(pair%in%c("single","CD45,CD20")))

visual_inspection<-function(samp){
  plots<-lapply(colnames(temp)[3:7],function(z) 
    filtered[[samp]]%>%filter(protein==z)%>%ggplot(aes(x=x,y=-y,col=signal))+
    geom_point(size=.1)+scale_color_viridis_c(option = 'H')+ggtitle(z))
  plots[[6]]<-filtered[[samp]]%>%
    filter((pair=="single"&!protein%in%c("CD45","CD20"))|
           (protein=="CD20"&pair!="single"))%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=x,y=-y,col=protein))+geom_point(size=.1)+
    guides(col=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5)))
  gridExtra::grid.arrange(grobs=plots)}
```

```{r}
library(dbscan)
temp<-filtered$SL260088%>%filter(protein=="KRT8")
temp$cl<-dbscan(temp[,1:2],eps = 1000,minPts = 100)$cluster
temp%>%ggplot(aes(x=x,y=-y,col=as.factor(cl)))+geom_point(size=1)

i<-temp%>%group_by(cl)%>%mutate(min_x=min(x),
                                max_x=max(x),
                                min_y=min(y),
                                max_y=max(y),
                                max_dist=sqrt((max_x-min_x)**2+(max_y-min_y)**2)%>%
  distinct(cl,max_dist)%>%arrange(max_dist)%>%head(-1)
i<-temp%>%filter(cl%in%i$cl)%>%distinct(x,y,cl)
temp<-filtered$SL260087%>%left_join(i)
 temp<-temp%>%filter((PGP95==1&CD45<0.6814541&CD10<0.2870845&CD20<0.6625389)|!is.na(cl))
 temp%>%mutate(paint=ifelse(is.na(cl),"PGP95",paste('cl',cl)))%>%ggplot(aes(x=x,y=-y,col=paint))+geom_point(size=.1)+guides(col=guide_legend(override.aes = list(size=5)))+labs(col="LA/PGP95")+xlim(0,80000)+ylim(-60000,0)
 
i%>%group_by(cl)%>%summarise(x=median(x),y=median(y))
```
